en: Catalogue of Sūtras, Śāstras, Commentaries, and Sub-commentaries Acquired at Kaien-ji Temple in Fukufu by the Japanese Student of the Dharma, Enchin.
A total count of one [volume]. Acquired at Kaien-ji Temple in Fukufu: sūtras, śāstras, commentaries, sub-commentaries, and so forth. Total count: one.
One hundred and fifty-six fascicles.
*Dharmādarśa-sūtra* (The Sutra of the Mirror of the Dharma) [fragment]. *Mahāyāna Vaipulya Prajñā-uttama-sūtra* (The Mahayana Vaipulya Sutra on Essential Wisdom), one fascicle.

*Mahāyāna Vajramukuṭa-bodhisattva-caryā-prakaraṇa* (The Mahayana Section on the Practice of the Bodhisattva Vajramukuṭa), one fascicle. *Mahāvaipulya Samantabhadra-bhāṣita-sūtra* (The Mahavaipulya Sutra Spoken by Samantabhadra), one fascicle. *Aṣṭasamādhi* (The Eight Samadhis). Not complete.
*Samādhi-mudrā-sūtra*, one fascicle; *Amoghapāśa-dhāraṇī-sūtra*, one fascicle; *Parama-viśeṣa-samādhi-sūtra*, one fascicle;
*Saddharma-puṇḍarīka-sūtra-śāstra*, one fascicle; translated by Ratnamati; *Prakaraṇāryavācā-śāstra-kārikā*, one fascicle;
*Nirākāra-śāstra*, two fascicles; *Nyāyamukha-śāstra*, one fascicle (upper and lower); translated by Yijing. Great [Collection].
*Chengguang Wuyun Lun* (The Treatise on the Five Aggregates by Vasubandhu), one fascicle; *Dazhou Qunjing Mulü* (Catalogue of Various Scriptures of the Great Zhou), two fascicles, upper and lower;

*Huayan Fahai* (The Dharma-Ocean of the Avataṃsaka), two fascicles, upper and lower; *Bashishanshen Tu* (Diagram of the Eight Consciousnesses and Three Bodies), one fascicle; *Daojin Chao* (Excerpts by Daojin), six fascicles; *Fahua Kewen* (Outline of the Lotus Sutra), two fascicles;
*Jiangxiang Jingmingjing Guanzhong Shu Luesuyi Tu* (Jiangxiang’s Brief Diagram of the Meaning of the Commentary on the Vimalakīrti Sūtra from Guanzhong), one fascicle; *Jinshizi* (Golden Lion).

*Guānmén* (Gates of Contemplation), one scroll; *Sìfēnlǜ yīnxùn* (Phonetic Glossary of the Four-Part Vinaya), one scroll; a set of one hanging scroll depicting the Transformation Images of the Upādhyāya;
one scroll containing the inscription and preface for the newly constructed stupa at Fuzhou Kaiyuan Temple;

one scroll containing the inscription and preface for the stele recording the construction of the Pure Land Hall and the transcription of all the scriptures at Kaiyuan Temple; and one record of the re-construction of the Scripture Repository by the Military Commissioner.
The above scrolls have been transcribed:

one bundle of Sanskrit mantras on palm leaves from the Great Nālandā Monastery in Central India, and one bundle of the *Sanskrit Amoghapāśa-hṛdaya-dhāraṇī*. These were bestowed by the Brahmin Tripiṭaka Master Ācārya Mañjusridhara.
One fascicle of the *Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva Image*, two fascicles of the *Bodhisattva Precepts Commentary* (upper and lower), one fascicle of the *Amitābha Sūtra Commentary*,
three fascicles of the *Vimalakīrti Sūtra Commentary* (upper, middle, and lower), one fascicle of the *Prajñāpāramitā-hṛdaya Sūtra Commentary*,
twenty fascicles of the *Avataṃsaka Sūtra Commentary*, ten fascicles of the *Profound Praise of the Lotus Sūtra*, ten fascicles of the *Lotus Sūtra Commentary*, and the *Nirvāṇa Sūtra*.

*Jīngshū* (Commentary on the Sūtras), ten fascicles; *Kāi sìfēnlǜzōngjì* (Record of the Opening of the Four-Part Vinaya School), ten fascicles; *Hóngtiáofúlù* (Record of the Propagation of Discipline), eight fascicles;

*Kāi sìfēnlǜzōngjìjìng* (Mirror of the Record of the Opening of the Four-Part Vinaya School), ten fascicles; *Sìfēnlǜkēwén* (Outline of the Four-Part Vinaya), one fascicle; *Sìfēnkāizōngjì* (Chronicle of the Opening of the School of the Four-Part Vinaya), eight fascicles;

*Chéngdūchāo* (Notes from Chengdu), one fascicle; *Zázhuǎnjiàngjù* (Miscellaneous Verses on Conversion and Subjugation), one fascicle; *Sìfēnbǐqiūnísuíyàoxíng* (Essential Practices for Bhikṣuṇīs of the Four-Part Vinaya).
Two fascicles of the *Vinaya-vidhi*; twelve fascicles of the *Abhidharmakośa-kārikā-bhāṣya-ṭīkā*; five fascicles of the *Abhidharmakośa-śāstra-vyākhyā-ṭīkā-ṭippaṇī*;
three fascicles of the *Abhidharmakośa-vyākhyā-kārikā-bhāṣya-ṭīkā-saṃgraha*; and one fascicle of the *Abhidharmakośa-prastāva-ṭīkā*.
The above were donated by the śramaṇas Changzhen, Cunsu, Huiruan, Zhikai, Yixiong, Sanliao, Ligua, and others.
One scroll of poems for seeing off [the Master]. On the twenty-first day of the □ month, I received the State Magistrate’s command to reside at Kaiyuan Temple.
Regarding the previous Dharma-gate, I have recorded it as it was obtained according to the circumstances, as listed above.
Recorded on the twenty-first day of the ninth month in the seventh year of the Dazhong era of the Great Tang by the monk Enchin, who seeks the Dharma in Japan.
